title: Front Cover
content: A pair of 25 cm long egg cases of the critically endangered flapper skate (Dipturus intermedius), nestled in between boulders during their 18-month development. This cover image relates to the Research Article “Monitoring a Flapper Skate (Dipturus intermedius) egg-laying site in Loch Melfort, Scotland, by a Community Science Group” [https://doi.org/10.1002/aqc.70374], by Smith et al. Photo credit: Chris Rickard, Shark and Skate Scotland.
